title: SCLITE scoring documentation
note: Inspect reference–hypothesis alignment and counts of substitutions, deletions and insertions. Record the scoring and normalization configuration alongside a reported WER.

title: P.808 · Subjective evaluation of speech quality with a crowdsourcing approach
note: Use its listening-test design, listener qualification and environment controls to structure a study. Its speech-quality task has a different construct from literary performance or speaker consent.

title: Racial disparities in automated speech recognition
note: The authors audited commercial recognition on US sociolinguistic interviews. Read cohort construction before interpreting disparities or extrapolating to other languages and communities.

title: IndicFDB · Benchmarking Full-Duplex Voice Agents across Indian Languages
note: Study the ten-language benchmark’s conversational event construction, synthetic interruptions, timing heuristics and translation-based judging. Translation and the selected conversations bound the conclusions.

title: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to Testing Statistical Significance in Natural Language Processing
by: Rotem Dror, Gili Baumer, Segev Shlomov and Roi Reichart
note: Work through the conditions each significance test assumes. Use the paper to motivate an explicit sampling unit and metric when comparing systems on the same data.

title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
note: Inspect position and verbosity biases and where model judges agreed with humans on text tasks. A speech rubric needs fresh validation with people who heard the audio.

title: VoiceBench · Benchmarking LLM-Based Voice Assistants
note: Read how controlled speaker, acoustic and content variations probe voice assistants. Its trials can motivate test fixtures, though an interactive listener may change behavior in response to the system.

title: Full-Duplex-Bench · A Benchmark to Evaluate Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models on Turn-taking Capabilities
note: The paper separates pause handling, backchannels, turn transitions and interruption. Use these event families to label replay cases and compare those results with a live conversation.

title: Traces
note: Read the span and parent–child model before designing a voice trace. A boundary such as audio reaching a listener’s ear still requires its own instrumentation.

title: Canarying Releases
note: Use its control-versus-canary method, exposure window and attribution discussion to design a rollback gate. Choose listener-facing indicators for speech workloads.

title: Monitoring Distributed Systems
note: Use latency, traffic, errors and saturation to structure a dashboard. Complement service metrics with playback, stale-audio and resume outcomes.

title: Orca · A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models
note: Follow insertion and removal of sequences at generation iterations. Its comparisons are specific to the tested model, hardware and workload.

title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
note: Trace how KV blocks reduce fragmentation under variable sequence lengths. The paper evaluates autoregressive language-model serving.

title: FlashAttention · Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
note: Its tiled computation illustrates the cost of moving data between GPU memory levels. Gains depend on workload shape and memory hierarchy.

title: Batchers · Triton Inference Server
note: Inspect dynamic queue delays and the sequence batcher for ordered, stateful requests. Trace the full client queue as well as the scheduler.

title: SmoothQuant · Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models
note: Track how rescaling addresses activation outliers for W8A8 transformer inference. Validate an ASR encoder or vocoder separately before borrowing that conclusion.

title: whisper.cpp
note: See supported CPU and accelerator backends, quantized weights and the sample-file CLI. Benchmark a specific revision and model on the target device.

title: Media Capture and Streams
note: Consult device-privacy indicators, capture permissions and track termination for a browser product. The specification concerns media access while a product also needs its own recording and retention state.

title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 · General Data Protection Regulation
note: Read Articles 4, 5, 9 and 17 for biometric identification, storage limitation, conditions and erasure exceptions. Determine applicability for the actual actors, jurisdictions and purposes.

title: Digital Identity Guidelines · Authentication and Authenticator Management (SP 800-63B-4)
note: Read §3.2.3 on biometric comparisons, presentation attacks and the voice restriction in this guideline. It addresses authentication assurance within its scope.

title: ASVspoof 5 evaluation plan · phase 2
note: Examine the spoofing and spoofing-aware verification tasks, operating costs and evaluation protocol. Re-evaluate against new generators and replay channels.

title: LLM01:2025 · Prompt Injection
note: Study indirect instructions in retrieved or multimodal content. Use the threat model to define independent authorization at each tool boundary.

title: SLSA v1.2 · Provenance
note: Use build and artifact identity to reconstruct which inputs produced a release. A provenance statement still requires verification against a trusted builder.
